description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] `altText` is a string for one image or one string per carousel slide in images / imageStorageIds order. Creates a DRAFT content item. Nothing is posted. Give `text` plus optional media (`videoUrl` / `imageUrl`, or `videoStorageId` / `imageStorageId` from upload_media, or `imageStorageIds` for 2-20 uploaded carousel images / `images` for 2-20 URLs), target `platforms`, `brandId` (from list_brands; omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard; required once the account is in more than one organization), per-platform captions (`platformText`), creator `credits`, `labels` and YouTube options. More optional arguments, not listed: instanceLabels, youtube, sourceLabel, contentType, copyFromContentId, referralFooter, credits. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"create_content"}.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content.)

altText.description: Format: JSON; e.g. "Example". Several shapes; describe_tool shows them.

text.description: Format: string; e.g. "Discover our new collection.".
